requests.prompt: Character model reference sheet for a 3D modeler, made to match the attached card painting exactly (same character, same proportions, same colors, same materials, same gear). Plain pure white background, no scenery, no text, no labels, no logos, no borders. Even soft studio lighting, crisp edges, chunky stylized 3D-rendered fantasy game style like the painting. Top row: the full character shown three times at the same size, standing in a neutral A-pose (arms angled down about 45 degrees away from the body, legs slightly apart, hands open and empty): front view, side view (facing left), back view. Whole body in frame, head to feet, nothing cropped. Bottom row: each accessory shown on its own, not held, at a readable size, in front, side and back views. CHARACTER: Gearward Sentinel, a giant hulking brass-and-bronze clockwork guardian robot (the big machine in the painting, NOT the small pink-haired gnome girl, who must not appear at all). Heavy riveted brass armor plates with dark bronze and iron joints, huge rounded shoulders, a short thick body with a broad chest, big riveted gauntlet hands, thick stumpy armored legs with large round knee joints and heavy feet. Its head is sunk low between the shoulders with one large round glowing blue eye lens; a glowing blue core and blue light seams in the chest and joints, small gear details and pipes, little puffs of steam from the back vents. Colors: warm polished brass and gold, dark bronze, iron grey, glowing cyan-blue lights, small purple crystal glints. ACCESSORIES (bottom row): 1) its brass spiked mace: a heavy round brass head with short spikes and a riveted band on a thick metal handle, front, side and back views. 2) its large round gear-shaped shield: a big brass cog wheel with chunky teeth around the rim, riveted center boss and a handle on the back, front, side and back views.
